title: Have wind and solar energy increased electricity price volatility? And what is electricity price volatility, anyway?
abstract: arXiv:2611.10731v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: It is widely held that wind and solar power increase the volatility of electricity prices. This paper argues that the literature conflates two distinct types of price variation: across delivery time and across trading time. Determined simultaneously in the same day-ahead auction, prices for power to be delivered in distinct quarter-hours differ. This price dispersion, which I call "variability", is rooted in non-storability. After that auction, trading continues in intraday markets until imbalance settlement. The price for the same delivery period changes as new information arises, e.g., weather forecasts. Such price "volatility" is ultimately caused by uncertainty. This paper develops a simple algebraic model of day-ahead and imbalance markets that provides a formal definition of variability and volatility, allows for a decomposition and derives the fundamental drivers, uncertainty and non-storability. translated_title: 风能和太阳能增加了电价波动性吗？究竟什么才是电价波动性？
translated_abstract: 人们普遍认为风能和太阳能电力会增加电价的波动性。本文认为，相关文献混淆了两种不同类型的价格变化：跨交付时间的变化与跨交易时间的变化。在同一天的日前拍卖中同时确定的价格，对于不同交付时段（以一刻钟为单位）的电力各不相同。我称这种价格离散为“变异性”，它根源于电力的不可储存性。在日前拍卖之后，交易在日内市场持续进行，直至不平衡结算。随着新信息的出现（例如天气预报），同一交付时段的价格会发生变化，这种价格“波动性”最终源于不确定性。本文构建了一个关于日前市场和不平衡市场的简单代数模型，为变异性与波动性提供了正式定义，支持对二者进行分解，并推导出其根本驱动因素——不确定性与不可储存性。随后，本文提供了实证数据……
tldr: 本文指出电价研究混淆了“变异性”（源于电力不可储存性的不同交付时段间的价格差异）与“波动性”（源于不确定性的同一交付时段价格随交易时间的变化），并构建代数模型为二者提供正式定义、分解方法及根本驱动因素。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that the literature conflates two distinct types of electricity price variation—"variability" (price dispersion across delivery periods, rooted in non-storability) and "volatility" (price changes over trading time, driven by uncertainty)—and develops an algebraic model of day-ahead and imbalance markets that formally defines and decomposes the two.
